products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates under the Merative name, offering products and services spanning clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular data management, health data analytics, and real-world evidence research.

The company's product portfolio includes several distinct platforms and product lines. Micromedex provides clinical decision support to equip clinicians with point-of-care insights. Zelta is a cloud-based clinical data management and acquisition platform designed for clinical trials programs. The Merge suite covers enterprise imaging and workflow tools, including Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, and the 2025 Best in KLAS ranked Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo for cardiovascular service lines. Truven offers health data analytics and consulting services described by the company as gold standard health data with predictive analytic capabilities.

The site's held facts classify Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, noting its work in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
